abstract_sentences.text: Despite the progress in the development of generative models, their usefulness in creating synthetic data that improve prediction performance of classifiers has been put into question.
Besides heuristic principles such as “synthetic data should be close to the real data distribution”, it is actually not clear which specific properties affect the generalization error.

evidence.anchor: not clear which specific properties affect the generalization error

abstract_sentences.text: Our paper addresses this question through the lens of high-dimensional regression.

Theoretically, we show that, for linear models, the covariance shift between the target distribution and the distribution of the synthetic data affects the generalization error but, surprisingly, the mean shift does not.

evidence.anchor: covariance shift affects ... mean shift does not

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore we prove that, in some settings, matching the covariance of the target distribution is optimal.
Remarkably, the theoretical insights from linear models carry over to deep neural networks and generative models.

evidence.anchor: carry over to deep neural networks

abstract_sentences.text: We empirically demonstrate that the covariance matching procedure (matching the covariance of the synthetic data with that of the data coming from the target distribution) performs well against several recent approaches for synthetic data selection, across training paradigms, architectures, datasets and generative models used for augmentation.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 synthetic-data selection 约化为 high-dimensional min-norm regression 的 covariance-induced risk optimization：mixed-data 中 mean shift 是可消失的低秩扰动，covariance matching 由定理和 selector 实验承接。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Q、single-class/linear scope、风险分解、Theorems 4.1/4.3/4.4/4.5、greedy selector、主 accuracy 表、两端对照和关键限制。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 证明技术、系数系统、weighted objective、model shift、训练超参数及 DINO/transformer/leak/over-param/distribution/规模/variant/text 结果移入 Appendix A–C。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 用 theory lines 与 empirical points 的三个面板映射 mean/covariance/sample-size 预测；Tables 1–3 固定训练范式并保留两端对照。
final_judgment.largest_gap: single-class regression 忽略 class interactions；over-parameterized optimum 只证明 Σt=Ip；深网迁移是有限 accuracy/diagnostic 证据而非机制保证。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先用可解释风险分解给出哪个 distributional moment 改变决策的可证伪命题，再用 quality/diversity/alignment 诊断和上下界对照验证 selector。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: conditional model shift、class interactions、OOD test 或 fairness/privacy 主导时，covariance matching 不自动成立，需要另建风险和证据。
